name: IBY_PAY_SERVICE_REQUESTS
description: IBY_PAY_SERVICE_REQUESTS stores payment process requests from source products. A payment process request is a group of documents payable that a source product submits to Oracle Payments for payment service processing. This table corresponds to the Payment Process Requests page.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: System-generated primary key.

columns.name: CALLING_APP_ID
columns.description: Source product Identifier

columns.name: CALL_APP_PAY_SERVICE_REQ_CODE
columns.description: Source product's payment process request identifier.

columns.name: PAYMENT_SERVICE_REQUEST_STATUS
columns.description: Payment process request status. Values from the lookup IBY_REQUEST_STATUSES include PAYMENTS_CREATED.

columns.name: PROCESS_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies the process by which documents payable are built into payments and payments into payment instructions. Values from the lookup IBY_PROCESS_TYPES include STANDARD, IMMEDIATE, and MANUAL.

columns.name: ALLOW_ZERO_PAYMENTS_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag that indicates whether zero payments are allowed for this payment request. If set to No, any zero value payments created for this payment request will be failed.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: INTERNAL_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Internal bank account identifier

columns.name: PAYMENT_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Payment process profile Identifier. This is mandatory if COMPLETE_INSTRUCTION_FLAG is Y.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum payment amount used to override default maximum payment amount

columns.name: MINIMUM_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum payment amount used to override default minimum payment amount

columns.name: DOCUMENT_REJECTION_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Specifies what is rejected if a document payable fails validation. Values from the IBY_DOCUMENT_REJECTION_LEVELS lookup include REQUEST, PAYEE, and DOCUMENT.

columns.name: PAYMENT_REJECTION_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Specifies how much of a payment process request is rejected if a payment fails validation. Values from the IBY_PAYMENT_REJECTION_LEVELS lookup include REQUEST, PAYMENT, and NONE.

columns.name: REQUIRE_PROP_PMTS_REVIEW_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating whether Oracle Payments should stop the payment creation flow to allow an administrator to review and modify proposed payments before grouping them into payment instructions. Values from the lookup IBY_PROPOSED_PMTS_REVIEW_CODES include Y and N.

columns.name: ORG_TYPE
columns.description: Organization type, such as business unit. Values taken from lookup: IBY_ORGANIZATION_TYPES

columns.description: Flag indicating whether the Build Payments program automatically kicks off the Create Payment Instructions program after payment build completes.
